description: Compare eligible supplier offers for the same requested SKUs, quantity and destination. This is read-only and returns estimated shipping separately from item subtotal.

destination.description: Buyer delivery destination for shipping estimates.

environment.description: Catalog environment. Only production listings are public.

items.description: Requested SKU lines used to compare complete supplier offers. Every quantity must meet that SKU MOQ and remain within confirmed sellable inventory.

quantity.description: Requested whole units; the server enforces MOQ and inventory.

name: compare_supplier_offers

outputSchema.description: Read-only complete supplier offers with subtotal, shipping and total. Each line exposes the unitPrice actually used, including a qualifying price break when supplier data provides one.
